// A default is a source: a parameter or destructuring default read off
// process.env or the os module reaches the host when no value is passed. A
// line ending in "// flagged" must be reported; every other line must pass.
import * as os from 'node:os';
function readHome({ HOME } = process.env) { return HOME; } // flagged
const arrowHome = ({ HOME: home } = process.env) => home; // flagged
const nestedHome = ({ env: { HOME } } = process) => HOME; // flagged
const innerDefault = ({ env: { HOME } = process.env }) => HOME; // flagged
const readHomedir = ({ homedir } = os) => homedir(); // flagged
function requiredHomedir({ homedir: read } = require('os')) { return read(); } // flagged
function osParameter(osModule = require('node:os')) { return osModule.homedir(); } // flagged
const methods = {
  read({ HOME } = process.env) { return HOME; }, // flagged
};
class Reader {
  read({ homedir } = os) { return homedir(); } // flagged
}
try { run(); } catch ({ env: { HOME } = process.env }) { use(HOME); } // flagged
const { fixture: { HOME: declared } = process.env } = fixtures; // flagged
const { HOME: withDefault = 'none' } = process.env; // flagged
// Fixture defaults, and parameters with no default, pass.
const fixtureHome = ({ HOME } = { HOME: 'fixture-home' }) => HOME;
const fixtureOs = ({ homedir } = { homedir: () => 'fixture-home' }) => homedir();
const passedEnv = ({ HOME }) => HOME;
const passedOs = (osModule) => osModule.homedir();
const { fixture: { HOME: fixtureDeclared } = { HOME: 'fixture-home' } } = fixtures;
